title: Common definitions
description: Definitions shared by every Primum format.

id.description: A UUID that identifies an entity for good. Files reference each other by id, never by path.

name.description: A name a person reads: shown in the UI, never used as a reference.

description.description: Free text that explains what something is for.

reference.description: The id of another file of the project, or of something defined in one (an element, a parameter). Never a path.

variableName.description: The name of a constant or a variable, as conditions will write it: a letter or _ first, then letters, digits or _.

valueType.description: The type of a value: number (with decimals), integer, boolean (true or false) or text.

value.description: A number, a boolean or a text.

durationMs.description: A length of time in milliseconds.

timeOfDay.description: A time of day, 24-hour HH:MM, local time.
